title: Defining Item Classes

children:
An item class identifies a group of items that share common characteristics, 
 such as unit of measure values and container dimensions. To minimize setup 
 time, create an item class for items that share the same unit of measure 
 values and container dimensions. On each item's record, identify the item 
 class instead of providing the unit of measure values and container dimensions. 
 You can use item classes to manage the movement of like items through 
 the warehouse. This is especially helpful for items that share the physical 
 dimensions and space requirements. For example, if your warehouse distributes 
 music CDs, 
 you could associate all individual CDs 
 with the CD item class. 
 Item classes are optional; you are not required to create them.

Use the Storage 
 Template Field to associate a storage template record with this 
 particular item class. A storage template identifies all the units of 
 measure that are associated with a general category of items.
